newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Mainland China judge seeks political asylum.
Two hand grenades found in southern Pingtung county.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Cop-killing suspect Liu Tsun-wang arrested.
A chief prosecutor in central Taiwan suspected of taking bribes.
LIBERTY TIMES - More than 20 veterans lose all money in investment in China.
Economy shows clear sign of recovery as investment obstacles removed.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - United Microelectronics Corp and Winbond Electronics Corp says they did not export momory chips to the United States at a price below fair value.
China Development's planned conversion into industrial bank faces difficulty.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan SRAM makers deny U.S. dumping charges.
Imminent direct shipping links boost business opportunities across Taiwan strait.
